units: Mic. II, 13;] leader of the flock (h. עַתּוּד), bell-wether, buck.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 10:8:2">Y. B. Kam. X, end, 7ᶜ</cite> if the restored sheep is as distinguishable <he>כגון אהן ב׳</he> as the barḥa.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 10:8:2">Ib.</cite> what does <he>כגון אהן ב׳</he> mean? Some say <cite ref="H00303"><he>חוטרא</he></cite> &c., v. <cite ref="Q01158"><he>פַּנְדּוּרָא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="M02898"><he>מַשְׂכּוֹכִית</he></cite>. Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:5">Ib. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ קרחא</he> a bald buck (sneer at R. Joshua b. Karḥa; v. <cite ref="C00351"><he>גַּוְזַנְיָא</he></cite>).
